copy.heading: What to wear
body: The engagement has received a number of reports about what you wear to occasions. They include a padel quarter-zip at a christening, court shoes at a wedding, a padel cap in a family photograph at your grandmother's ninetieth, and a pair of padel shorts at a children's party in February.
Padel kit is for padel. Other occasions have their own clothes, which you already own. They are in the wardrobe, behind the padel kit.
